'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Steve Yaeger DS Drop! (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Yaeger]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Drop! (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)|OVS8-32-Drop-remaster.webp|label=Drop! (V)}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Steven Yaeger
* '''Deck name:''' Bare Bones Killer "The Pride of Richmond"
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
